**Preserve tick-stamp-only transitions.**

This emits nothing whenever only `lastWeeklyTickWeek` changes, although the slice contract defines either elapsed-week advancement **or** a tick-stamp update as a weekly transition. Model that transition and its prior/next stamp in the summary, propagate it through note metadata/allowlisting, and add a zero-elapsed-delta regression test before marking that acceptance item complete.

equals nextElapsed; include the prior and next tick stamps in the summary.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Include tick-stamp-only channel transitions**

For records with an authored zero weekly delta (`weeklyElapsedWeeksDelta: 0`), the SPE-2643 tick still changes the channel by stamping `lastWeeklyTickWeek`, but `priorElapsed === nextElapsed` here causes the summary to be dropped. The slice contract in `planning/spe-956-participatory-channel-weekly-report-note-slice-1.md` says weekly notes should surface five-map changes from elapsed advances and/or tick-week stamps, so these valid tick transitions become invisible in the weekly report.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Update SPE-956 registry deferred status**

Adding this active report-note type ships the SPE-2646 weekly surfacing, but `SCHEMA_REGISTRY.md` still lists ΓÇ£Weekly report-note surfacingΓÇ¥ under the SPE-956 participatory channel Deferred siblings. That leaves the persistence registry telling future agents this surface is unshipped even though the type is now persisted/hydrated, so the registry should be updated with the shipped weekly-note surfacing instead of leaving it deferred.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Use the closed report week for channel notes**

When advancing from week N, `finalizeEvents` has already appended a weekly report whose `week` is the closed source week, while `result.week` has been advanced to N+1. Passing `result.week` here gives the SPE-956 notes timestamps and metadata for the next week even though they are attached to the just-closed report, so save/load hydration can rewrite those timestamps and metadata consumers see the wrong week. Use the last report's week/closed week for these appended notes.
